headline: Gayatri Projects Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Gayatri Projects Limited has informed the Exchange that it has been awarded a new project by Bengaluru Integrated Rail Infrastructure Development Enterprise Limited (B-RIDE) under a Joint Venture.
